def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Locate the full-width or full-height 2 boundary and the non-background object.
    line = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if line is not None:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
        obj=min(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
        top=min(r for r,c in pts); bottom=max(r for r,c in pts)
        delta=(line+1)-top if line < top else (line-1)-bottom
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r+delta][c]=obj
        mark=(bottom+delta+1) if line<top else (top+delta-1)
        for c in range(w): out[mark][c]=8
        return out
    line = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
    obj=min(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    left=min(c for r,c in pts); right=max(c for r,c in pts)
    delta=(line+1)-left if line < left else (line-1)-right
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c+delta]=obj
    mark=left-1 if line<left else right+1
    for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
    return out
